summary: With João Pedro out, Rogers has moved up front and two previews have Estêvão starting against Leeds. When João Pedro returns, Estêvão is the likeliest to lose his place.

claims.text: Some hope he could feature against Leeds, citing journalist Simon Phillips, but nothing is guaranteed; he has missed the last three league games.
